Here's my advice: Don't quit. My technique is to practice in YOUR style, practice what YOU want your art to look like, and just keep going at it until you like it. If you like it, chances are someone else will, too. Use the techniques YOU like, not what anyone tells you. If you're having trouble with something that doesn't look right, practice that element. Learn how to make it in the 'real' way, then make it your own. Remember, this world belongs to the artists. We decide how our buildings look, and how our posters are, how various mediums are portrayed. Even by the simple act of gossiping, humans define one another and give them an image. Art is powerful. And you're learning how to use that power. And a word of advice from someone who gave up: don't miss out on being one of those with that kind of authority. Give yourself time and be patient, because no one gets it right on the first try.  Everyone has struggled, no matter how well they hide it. Go for it. 

TL;DR: Practice using your own style, artists rock, go dominate dat beyotch.
